title: Simple Pet Owner Check
description: Easily see the owner of a pet!
body:
Easily view the owner of a pet by right-clicking it!

## Why Use This
A super simple plugin to view the names of tamed animals. Players often have to use a mod to view the owner of tamed animals. This plugin can display it in chat.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4458735ba69a5e6f158e02f9d88868088692ea14.png)

## Commands

None

## Permissions

None

## How To Use

Simply right-click a tamed animal.

## Requirements / Dependencies
None
